heading: Development Authority Reviews Tax Increment Districts
summary: Economic development staff briefed the authority on the city's tax increment districts. The update followed the Joint Review Board's annual meeting. Staff walked members through the districts as part of the public meeting.

heading: Wisconsin DOJ Opens Outreach on Generic Drug Settlement Claims
summary: Wisconsin DOJ urged consumers to check their eligibility for payments tied to generic drug settlements. The states received preliminary approval of their plan to distribute funds. The cases involve allegations that drugmakers coordinated to inflate generic drug prices.
